name: @approov/approov-service-react-native
title: Approov React Native Service Layer
description: Approov Mobile App Protection for ReactNative

scripts.start:
echo "*** This package is not runnable. *** To get started, run: npx @approov/react-native-approov:
" && npx @approov/react-native-approov; exit 0
scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -project ios/Approov.xcodeproj -scheme Approov -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' clean build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.prepack: node -e "if (process.platform === 'darwin') { require('child_process').execSync('npm run build:ios', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { console.log('Skipping iOS build on non-macOS platform ' + process.platform); }"
